tables.title: Effect of low-power modes on DAC
tables.text_helper: Table 163, "Effect of low-power modes on DAC", in section 22.5 (DAC in low-power modes) on page 692. Columns: Mode, Description. 3 data row(s). Notes: 1. Refer to Section22.3: DAC implementation for information on the Stop modes supported by the DAC peripheral.

rows: No effect, DAC used with DMA.

The DAC remains active with a static value. The sample and hold mode can be 
selected using LSE/LSI clock.

The DAC peripheral is powered down and must be reinitialized after exiting 
Standby mode.
notes: 1. Refer to Section22.3: DAC implementation for information on the Stop modes supported by the DAC peripheral.
